title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Carbohydrate Sampling Mission

shots.visual: POV walks into a warm yellow-lit kitchen. DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, blue and white gradient ponytail swinging, a small whale fin accessory on top of her head, loose home T-shirt, barefoot, up on tiptoe; she scoops a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster's. The kitchen behind her is soft and blurred, cool blue-white light on her hair against the warm room.
shots.shot_size: wide from the doorway, pushing to medium

camera.move: slow handheld push-in from the doorway

shots.lighting: warm 3000K tungsten kitchen key from the left, cool blue rim light on her ponytail, shallow depth of field so the background behind her is blurred
shots.character_action: on tiptoe behind the counter, shovels rice with chopsticks, tilts her head slightly at the footsteps but keeps her back to the camera and chews hard
shots.expression: cheeks packed, eyes half-closed in bliss, jaw working fast

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded... Take another bite--

sfx.cue: moist, loud chewing ba-jie ba-jie, with reverb matching POV distance

overlays.style: thin progress bar with percentage label

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience: boiling water plus a distant TV

shots.visual: POV freezes. The owner's right hand enters from the right edge of the frame and taps the dining table twice. DeepSeek Whale Maiden freezes mid-bite, chopsticks suspended in the air, blue and white ponytail completely still, the whale fin accessory on top of her head tilting; she slowly turns her head toward the lens, pupils trembling, the highlights in her eyes turning into rotating circles, food still packed in her mouth.

camera.move: locked off, owner's hand enters frame right

shots.lighting: same warm tungsten kitchen light, cool blue rim light on her hair, her iris highlights turning into rotating circles
shots.character_action: whole body freezes mid-bite, chopsticks suspended, slow robotic head turn toward the lens
shots.expression: pupils trembling, spiral highlights in her eyes, mouth full and unmoving

sfx.cue: two crisp taps on the dining table: dong, dong

shots.visual: POV, playback 1.5x. DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth, blue and white ponytail whipping, whale fin accessory bouncing, rice grains flying; her cheeks bulge to bursting and rice catches all over her T-shirt collar; the handheld frame shakes as the owner takes a step back.

camera.move: slight handheld shake, small step back

shots.lighting: warm tungsten key, cool blue rim light, shallow focus with rice grains flying through the beam
shots.character_action: scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth in fast shovels, steps back, keeps her eyes on the lens
shots.expression: panicked, eyes wide and pleading, cheeks bulging to bursting

body: rice grains on the T-shirt collar

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning!

sfx.cue: fast swallowing and chopsticks rattling against the bowl
spring boing plus a subjective heartbeat

overlays.text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.on_screen_text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.visual: POV extreme close-up. DeepSeek Whale Maiden leans right into the lens, still shovelling rice; rice grains smear directly onto the glass and stick there, breaking the fourth wall; her cheeks bulge to bursting, rice stuck all over her T-shirt collar, the whale fin accessory crooked on her head, her eyes begging you; she backs off and the handheld frame shakes.

camera.move: handheld, she leans into the lens then backs away

shots.lighting: warm tungsten key with a cool blue rim, smeared rice glowing on the glass
shots.character_action: leans into the lens while shovelling rice, then backs away with her hands up, still chewing
shots.expression: pleading eyes, cheeks bulging, rice grains stuck to her lips

body: rice grains on the T-shirt collar

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

sfx.cue: rice grains hitting the lens, soft wet taps

shots.bgm: fast-paced choral track at its peak

shots.visual: Reverse shot from the owner's position. DeepSeek Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight: two rice grains on her lips, the whale fin accessory tilted on her head, blue and white gradient ponytail, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, her belly visibly bulging a little under the loose home T-shirt. She clears her throat and smiles into the lens.
shots.lighting: warm 3200K tungsten key from the left, soft cool blue fill, kitchen bokeh behind her
shots.character_action: swallows, stands up straight, hands behind her back, chin up, small dignified nod
shots.expression: innocent yet smug, corners of the mouth twitching, one wink held back

body: two rice grains on her lips

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Semantic integrity check! The DeepSeek taste model needs training data... Don't look at me.

overlays.style: DeepSeek-style chat bubble with a tick

shots.bgm: choral track drops to a low hum

shots.visual: POV. A floating window styled like the DeepSeek UI pops up above DeepSeek Whale Maiden's head. She flicks the rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks at the lens, then gently pushes the camera away with her open palm; the picture briefly blurs from the contact.

camera.move: camera pushed back by her palm, drifting out of focus

shots.lighting: warm tungsten key, cool blue rim light, defocus bloom as her palm covers the glass
shots.character_action: flicks rice grains off her lips, winks, pushes the lens away with her palm
shots.expression: smug, eyes curved into a smile

cleared: two rice grains on her lips
